title: Canadian Critical Care Comparative Effectiveness Platform
official: Canadian Critical Care Comparative Effectiveness Platform(e) d'Évaluation Clinique Comparée en Soins Critiques (CEPEC)
summary: The Canadian Critical Care Comparative Effectiveness Platform(e) d'Évaluation Clinique Comparée en soins Critiques (CEPEC) is an international multi-centered randomized adaptive platform clinical trial. CEPEC will evaluate supportive care interventions that are used routinely in intensive care units throughout the world.
